decision: Approve the MTU-H5 RP-003/RP-004 q19 governed planning packet as a remote-available blocked-lane review packet. The packet is evidence-complete for review and machine-checkable, but it does not authorize q19 source extraction, graph/PV work, mapper repair, candidate writes, protected-reference mutation, lesson output, or product use.

review_team_threshold.first_round_condition: Quality inspection required remote publication before final approval.

review_team.summary: Teacher review found the packet didactically trustworthy as a blocked q19 planning packet, with clear teken answer-form expectations, misconception hooks, procedure-review state, and no material improvements required.

Economist review found the q19 market-shift decomposition aligned with the official correction model: Curacao labor demand to wage rise, Curacao goods/services market to inflation rise, and Aruba goods/services market to inflation rise, with A45 correctly weak-only.

Quality inspection found the packet remote-available at the reviewed commit, checker-backed, live-validator-bound, explicit about negative guards, and clean of protected-reference, candidate-storage, and source-extraction writes.

approved_findings: q19 remains blocked by q19-source-annex-gap and q19-graph-object-gap.
The instruction word teken still lacks approved graph/draw answer-form MTU coverage or reviewed equivalent.
A42 and D10 are supporting graph-shift candidates; D13 is partial linked-market reasoning support; A81 is source-use support.
